lcv.name: League of Conservation Voters
lcv.notes: National Environmental Scorecard. score = 2025 score (share of LCV-selected 2025 environmental roll call votes cast in the pro-environment direction; first session of the 119th Congress); lifetime = LCV lifetime score across all years served. LCV counts missed votes against the member. score is null where LCV shows N/A for 2025 (e.g. Speaker Mike Johnson, who rarely votes). Members newly sworn in after the 2025 scorecard with no LCV score shown (Armstrong OK-Sen, Fuller GA-14, Mejia NJ-11, Menefee TX-18) and members not listed at all (Gallagher CA-01, Blair GA-13, Wahab CA-14) are omitted. Collected from the member list page and its ?chamber=house&state=XX filtered views.

heritage.name: Heritage Action for America
heritage.notes: Heritage Action Scorecard 119. score = the 'Session Score' shown on each member page (page title labels it 'Scorecard 119'), covering key votes and weighted cosponsorships Heritage Action has scored in the 119th Congress to date; the scorecard updates weekly while Congress is in session, so this is a snapshot as of the fetch date. lifetime = Heritage Action lifetime score. Read from individual member pages at heritageaction.com/scorecard/members/{bioguide}; the list/search pages load data by script and show no members. Coverage: 529 of 539 current members of Congress. Members not included: pages that returned a server error or a broken page when fetched (several non-voting delegates and some newly seated members), and one page that did not state its chamber. A null value means the page showed N/A for that score.
